newsitem.title: USA: Peoples Gas customers get offer from affiliate.
newsitem.headline: Peoples Gas customers get offer from affiliate.

text.p: Consolidated Natural Gas Co said Wednesday homeowners, landlords and tenants served by its Peoples Natural Gas Co subsidiary can save an average of 10 percent on the natural gas portion of their annual utility bill -- about $40 a year -- and lock in their price for up to four years under an offer from another subsidiary -- Peoples Energy.
The offer also includes the convenience of still receiving a single monthly natural gas bill showing Peoples Energy's natural gas price and Peoples Natural Gas' transmission costs, Consolidated said.
It said Peoples Energy is the first energy marketer to participate in the new "Energy Choice" program initiated by Peoples Natural Gas on April 1.

The offer from Peoples Energy guarantees that a typical residential customer using 120,000 cubic feet of gas during the year will save 10 percent on the commodity cost of natural gas compared with the average rate charged by Peoples Natural Gas during the last 12 months, Consolidated said.
While the amount of savings depends on the amount of natural gas used, a typical homeowner can expect a savings of about $40 a year, the company explained.
It said customers can lock in their price for one, two or four years, thus protecting themselves from rising gas prices in the future.
Customers who sign up for two or four years will be eligible for added benefits under the exclusive "Power Rewards" program, Consolidated said.
Four-year customers will receive an additional 20 percent off gas costs on the bill they receive in December 1997.
